title: Faisal Town Block B Islamabad – Map, Plots & Prices
description: Explore Faisal Town Block B in Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad with map guidance, plot sizes, current resale prices, availability and buyer checks.
intro:
Faisal Town Block B is an established residential block within Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad. Buyers commonly compare Block B plots by size, street position, road width, access, possession, surrounding development and current resale price.

Current market listings show active 8 marla, 10 marla and larger residential plot inventory. Always verify the exact plot, dues, documentation and physical location before making an offer.
body:
## Faisal Town Block B overview

Faisal Town Block B is part of Faisal Town Phase 1 in F-18 Islamabad.

It is an established resale market with residential and commercial property activity, and current property portals show a substantial number of active listings.

Buyers commonly compare Block B with Block A and Block C based on plot size, exact street, access, surrounding development and total purchase cost.

The block name alone is not enough to judge value. Two properties of the same size can have very different asking prices because of their exact location.

## Faisal Town Block B location and map

Block B sits within Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 and should be reviewed using the relevant Phase 1 map rather than a Faisal Town Phase 2 sector plan.

Project-focused sources place Block B beside Block A and parallel to the M-1 Motorway. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

Before shortlisting a property, confirm:

- exact plot number
- street number
- road width
- corner or standard location
- main-road position
- nearby commercial or community areas
- access route
- surrounding occupancy

A map is useful for initial comparison, but a physical site visit should be used to confirm the actual location.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Block B

Current Phase 1 information and active market listings support several residential plot sizes in Block B.

Common residential sizes include:

- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

Current listings strongly confirm active 8 marla and 10 marla inventory, while 1 kanal plots also appear in the resale market. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

Always verify the exact dimensions from the property documents because portal descriptions and rounded marla labels can vary.

## Faisal Town Block B plots for sale

Block B currently has an active resale market.

Recent listings include multiple 8 marla / 30 x 60 plots, 10 marla / 35 x 70 plots and larger residential options. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

When comparing properties, establish whether each listing represents:

- a numbered plot
- an open file
- fully paid inventory
- property with outstanding dues
- corner or special-location inventory
- a standard internal-street plot

Do not assume that two listings of the same size are financially equivalent.

## Block B prices

There is no single fixed price for every Block B plot.

Current portal listings illustrate a wide range even within the same size category.

For example, recent 8 marla listings have appeared roughly around PKR 1.33 crore to PKR 1.85 crore depending on location and other factors, while 10 marla listings have appeared around approximately PKR 1.9 crore to PKR 2.3 crore. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

A recent 1 kanal listing was advertised around PKR 4.3 crore. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

These are seller asking prices, not official values or guaranteed transaction prices.

Use them only as a current market reference.

## What affects Block B plot prices

The main price factors include:

- plot size
- street and road width
- corner position
- main-road location
- plot level
- nearby commercial activity
- park-facing or open-facing position
- possession status
- outstanding dues
- exact access
- surrounding houses and construction
- seller urgency

A corner 8 marla plot can command a noticeably different asking price from a standard 8 marla plot in another street.

For that reason, compare like-for-like plots rather than relying on one average.

## Block B development and surroundings

Block B is generally presented in current Phase 1 sources as an established and developed area with possession delivered in much of the block. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6}

However, the exact property should still be inspected.

During a visit, check:

- road condition
- drainage
- street width
- surrounding occupancy
- nearby construction
- utility condition
- accessibility
- plot level
- commercial activity nearby

Do not assume every street has identical surroundings simply because the block is established.

## Block B for end users

Block B may suit buyers who prefer an established Phase 1 environment and want to inspect an actual residential location before buying.

For family use, consider:

- access to the street
- noise
- surrounding houses
- nearby commercial activity
- street width
- plot orientation
- practical route to the main road

A cheaper plot may not necessarily be the better choice if the street environment is less suitable for your intended use.

## Block B for investors

Investors may focus more on resale liquidity, plot size, road position and how easily the location can be marketed to future buyers.

Before buying for investment, compare:

- current asking prices
- number of similar listings
- exact plot position
- premium location features
- current development
- likely resale audience
- total acquisition cost

Avoid assuming that every property in Block B will appreciate at the same rate.

## Block B house versus plot

A house and a residential plot should be compared differently.

For a plot, check:

- dimensions
- street
- location
- dues
- possession
- transfer status

For a house, also inspect:

- construction age
- structural condition
- seepage
- electrical work
- plumbing
- finishing
- layout
- repairs
- renovation cost
- occupancy status

If you are open to both, shortlist houses and plots separately so construction quality does not distort the land-value comparison.

## Block B vs Block A and Block C

Block B should be compared with Block A and Block C using the exact property rather than the block name alone.

Compare:

- same plot size
- road width
- access
- asking price
- surrounding development
- corner or standard position
- possession
- total payable amount

One block may have a higher average asking price while another offers a stronger individual plot at the same budget.

The best choice therefore depends on the property, not just the block.

## What to check before buying in Block B

Before making an offer, confirm:

1. The property is in Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Block B.
2. The exact plot and street number.
3. Plot dimensions.
4. Ownership documentation.
5. Transfer status.
6. Outstanding dues.
7. Possession status.
8. Corner, main-road or other premium position.
9. Actual site condition.
10. Total purchase and transfer cost.

If the property cannot be matched confidently to the map and paperwork, resolve that issue before making payment.

## Block B site-visit checklist

During your site visit, check:

- exact plot number
- road width
- approach from main access
- plot level
- surrounding construction
- street condition
- drainage
- nearby commercial activity
- occupied houses
- any special-location feature

If you are buying remotely, request a live video call rather than relying only on an old recorded walkthrough.

## Do not confuse Block B with Faisal Town Phase 2

Block B on this page refers to Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18.

Faisal Town Phase 2 uses sector and enclave references such as Sector O, Sector P, Sector R, Sector S, Sector T and Overseas Enclave.

If a listing uses unclear wording, ask the seller to confirm the exact phase and map reference before comparing it with Block B inventory.
